sources.name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC)
sources.verdict: Verified live. Central commercial register: company-name (denominaciones) search, registered-company lookup, statistics; full extracts are paid via Registradores. Good for existence checks; bulk data flows via BORME instead.

sources.name: Registradores de España — Información Mercantil (Registro Mercantil online)
sources.verdict: Official paid channel for mercantile extracts (notas simples, deposited accounts). Per-document fee, credential-gated; use for targeted enrichment, not bulk.

sources.name: BORME open-data API (BOE datos abiertos)
sources.verdict: Verified: GET /datosabiertos/api/borme/sumario/{yyyymmdd} returns JSON/XML daily summary linking every commercial-register act (incorporations, administrators, insolvencies, capital changes). THE free machine route to Spanish company events — highest-yield source in the country.

sources.name: BOE — Boletín Oficial del Estado open-data API
sources.verdict: Verified. Same API family as BORME for the state gazette (laws, public-sector acts, sanctions, concessions). JSON/XML daily sumarios; high yield for regulatory and concession signals.

sources.name: CNMV — Registros de entidades (Búsqueda por entidad)
sources.verdict: Verified live. One portal over all CNMV registers: SGIIC/SGEIC fund managers, ESIs, IICs/UCITS, venture-capital entities (SCR/FCR/EICC), foreign AIFMs passported in. Server-rendered, enumerable lists — core GP/ManCo harvest.

sources.name: CNMV — Entidades de capital riesgo register (SCR/FCR/FESE/EICC)
sources.verdict: Listado route of the same portal for registered venture-capital/closed-ended vehicles; exact listado id should be confirmed at harvest time, but register is public and enumerable. Direct map of the Spanish PE/VC fund universe.

sources.name: CNMV — descarga de ficheros de información individual de IIC
sources.verdict: Bulk download section for per-fund IIC filings (prospectuses, periodic reports) referenced on the portal; route exists though the exact URL should be re-resolved from the portal menu. Fund-level depth at $0.

sources.name: CNMV — MiCA crypto-asset service provider (CASP) register
sources.verdict: Verified via search: CNMV is the MiCA authority; public CASP register (~134 providers incl. passported) published on the portal. Tokenized-RWA/crypto coverage.

sources.name: Banco de España — Registro de Entidades (search + record download)
sources.verdict: Verified via search (old /wbe/ URL 404s — use app.bde.es/rbe_spa). Banks, EFCs (specialty lenders), payment/e-money firms, appraisal companies; current + historical data, downloadable records. Core credit-side register.

sources.name: Banco de España — sociedades de tasación (registered appraisal companies)
sources.verdict: Valuation companies are one entity class inside the BdE register — the official Spanish valuer roll (real-assets service graph). Same access route as above.

sources.name: DGSFP — registros públicos (insurers, pension funds, gestoras de fondos de pensiones, mediadores)
sources.verdict: Verified live (homepage; registers behind 'Registros públicos' section). The LP side: pension funds and their management companies, insurers. Register search apps; some lists downloadable.

sources.name: FROB — Spanish bank resolution authority
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; well-known official body. Resolution decisions and stake disposals (distressed/NPL signals). Low volume, high value.

sources.name: Registro Público Concursal (RPC)
sources.verdict: Verified via search as the official insolvency register (Ministry of Justice / Colegio de Registradores). Free search by NIF/name across edictos, resoluciones, acuerdos extrajudiciales; no bulk API — BORME + BOE edicts are the machine route, RPC for lookups.

sources.name: CENDOJ — judicial decisions search (Poder Judicial)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; long-standing public case-law search incl. mercantile/insolvency rulings. Useful for litigation-funding and distressed research; form-driven search.

sources.name: Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público (PLACSP)
sources.verdict: Verified live; has an open-data section with bulk ATOM/XML syndication of tenders and awards. Infrastructure/concession deal flow (EPC contractors, concessionaires).

sources.name: INE — DIRCE central business directory / statistics
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; INE's DIRCE gives company-population statistics (not per-company records) as downloadable tables + JSON API (servicios web INE). Context layer, not entity records.

sources.name: datos.gob.es — national open-data catalog (apidata)
sources.verdict: Catalog page rendered empty to fetcher (JS) but the documented REST API (apidata) is the machine route over thousands of public datasets. Discovery layer for regional registers.

sources.name: BME — Bolsas y Mercados Españoles listed companies
sources.verdict: Verified live (site hub; listed-companies section + Download Center). Issuer lists, indices, statistics. Pair with CNMV disclosure feeds for filings.

sources.name: BME Growth — growth-market issuers incl. SOCIMIs
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; BME Growth publishes issuer lists where most Spanish SOCIMIs (private REITs) list — the SOCIMI census route. Confirm exact listado URL at harvest.

sources.name: MARF — Mercado Alternativo de Renta Fija (alternative fixed income)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; MARF issuer/programme lists = private-debt issuance map (direct lending adjacent, securitization fund SPVs). Part of verified bolsasymercados.es site.

sources.name: CNMV — Información privilegiada / Otra Información Relevante (issuer disclosures)
sources.verdict: Verified via search: daily IP/OIR disclosure lists plus an RSS/subscription page (cnmv.es/portal/gpage?id=RSS) and real-time email subscriptions. Issuer-event firehose.

sources.name: SpainCap (ex-ASCRI) — member lists + annual directory
sources.verdict: Verified via search: ~186 GP members, 107 advisors, 26 LP members listed on socios pages; annual Anuario PDF (spaincap.org/storage/documents/2025/01/anuario-2025.pdf) is a full directory. /en/partners/ 404s — use the socios routes.

sources.name: INVERCO — funds & pension funds association statistics
sources.verdict: Verified live. Monthly/quarterly Excel statistics on funds, pension plans and their gestoras — LP-side AUM context and manager league tables at $0.

sources.name: AEB — Asociación Española de Banca (member banks)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; well-known association with member list and banking statistics. Cross-check against BdE register.

sources.name: CECA — savings-banks association
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; member entities (CaixaBank et al heritage sector) and sector reports.

sources.name: UNACC — credit cooperatives association
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; rural/credit co-op member list — long-tail LP/lender entities.

sources.name: ASNEF — consumer & specialty finance association
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; members = consumer lenders/EFCs (specialty finance). Cross-check with BdE EFC register.

sources.name: AEF — Asociación Española de Factoring
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; member list + factoring/confirming volumes — trade/supply-chain finance mapping. Verify URL at harvest.

sources.name: UNESPA — insurance association
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; insurer members and sector reports — LP-side (insurance capital) context.

sources.name: ICO — Instituto de Crédito Oficial
sources.verdict: Verified (axispart.com serves ICO-group content). State promotional bank: credit lines, bonds, annual reports, press. Anchor DFI entity.

sources.name: AXIS / Fond-ICO Global (ICO group fund-of-funds)
sources.verdict: Verified: resolves into ICO-group site describing AXIS as the group's capital-riesgo gestora. Fond-ICO Global award rounds are public — LP-commitment signals for Spanish GPs.

sources.name: COFIDES — development finance for internationalization
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; state DFI co-investing in Spanish companies abroad; publishes portfolio and press.

sources.name: ENISA — state startup/venture-debt lender
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; participative loans to startups — venture-debt-adjacent signals and portfolio news.

sources.name: CDTI — innovation agency (Innvierte co-investment)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; Innvierte program co-invests with VCs; award publications = deal signals.

sources.name: SEPI — state industrial holding company
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; state shareholdings portfolio and disposals — privatization/state-asset side.

sources.name: Sareb — state bad bank (NPL/REO portfolios)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; portfolio sales and servicer contracts are prime Spanish NPL signals; publishes press and reports.

sources.name: ICEX / Invest in Spain
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; FDI promotion agency; announcements are inbound-investment signals.

sources.name: RENADE — Spanish national section of the EU ETS Union Registry
sources.verdict: Verified via search: account holder registry + EU-ETS transaction info pages under MITECO/OECC. Carbon-alts entity anchor; account lists limited but installation/operator data public via MITECO.

sources.name: AEV — Asociación Española de Análisis de Valor (appraisal companies)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; association of BdE-registered valuation companies; member list complements the BdE tasación register. Verify URL at harvest.

sources.name: Abogacía Española — census of lawyers / bar directory
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; national bar council with censo search; use for law-firm service-graph verification only (no bulk personal-data harvest, per project law).

sources.name: REFOR — Registro de Economistas Forenses (insolvency practitioners)
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; economists' insolvency-administrator body, publishes concursal statistics and practitioner info. Private-debt service graph.

sources.name: Fondo de Garantía de Depósitos — member entities
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; deposit-guarantee scheme member list — cross-check of the deposit-taking universe.

sources.name: AEFI — Asociación Española de FinTech e InsurTech
sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; fintech member directory — origination layer for specialty finance and crypto entities.

sources.name: Expansión (Unidad Editorial) — RSS
sources.verdict: Feed VERIFIED working (portada; section feeds exist on same CDN pattern, e.g. /rss/economia.xml, /rss/empresas.xml). Top-tier Spanish financial daily; M&A, banking, funds.

sources.name: Cinco Días (El País Economía)
sources.verdict: Fetcher blocked from cincodias.elpais.com this run; the elpais.com feeds host serves the mrss feed pattern recorded here — re-verify from a normal crawler UA. Strong companies/markets coverage.

sources.name: El Confidencial — empresas/mercados feeds
sources.verdict: rss.elconfidencial.com refused this fetcher; the /empresas/ and /mercados/ feed paths are the publisher's documented pattern — re-verify with standard UA. Best Spanish outlet for deal scoops and distressed stories.

sources.name: elEconomista.es — RSS index

sources.name: Europa Press — economía/finanzas wire RSS

sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; known for banking/distressed scoops. Hunt /feed at activation.

sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; strong banking and energy coverage; RSS route unconfirmed.

sources.verdict: Not fetched this run; economics-focused digital daily; RSS route unconfirmed.

sources.verdict: Feed VERIFIED working, hourly, current. Asset-management trade press: gestoras, mandates, private-markets funds. High signal for categories 1-4 and service graph.

sources.name: Funds Society (ES edition)

sources.verdict: Feed VERIFIED working, current. Energy/renewables projects, PPAs, auctions — transition-infrastructure deal flow.

sources.verdict: VERIFIED live. Academic-rooted Spanish VC/PE transparency initiative; 30k+ article archive, reports, newsletter. Both a news source and a methodology reference.

sources.verdict: RSS hub page verified via search (feed catalog page — extract concrete channel URLs from it at activation). Authorizations, sanctions, warnings, new registrations.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Spanish GPs/LPs and fund performance covered top-down; thin on mid-market and regional service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CNMV SGIIC/SGEIC and capital-riesgo registers, DGSFP pension-fund register (LP side), fund annual accounts filed via Registro Mercantil/BORME — all directly accessible to us.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Good on Spanish VC rounds and PE deals via press mining; weaker on debt, NPL, real assets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: BORME incorporation/capital-increase events, CNMV registers, SpainCap yearbook, startup press (El Referente-class outlets) — we can consume the same gazette + press layer.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Startup/VC ecosystem mapping incl. Spain hubs (endorsed by public agencies).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Public startup announcements, ENISA/CDTI award publications, accelerator lists, BORME-derived company data via local data resellers.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow Spanish startup coverage, self-reported heavy.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases and startup media; little registry depth — our BORME/CNMV route out-depths it.

competitorAnalysis.platform: TTR Data — Transactional Track Record (Iberia/LatAm local champion)
competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: VERIFIED live. The Iberian M&A/PE/VC/capital-markets deal database; claims 3x more local data than globals; monthly league tables.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: BORME acts, CNMV IP/OIR disclosures, BME/MARF listings, insolvency edicts, law-firm deal announcements — every one a public source we catalog above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: VERIFIED live. Spanish M&A/PE deal intelligence + yearbook + magazine; strong advisor/deal attribution.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Deal press releases, advisor submissions, BORME confirmations, SpainCap directory.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Full Spanish company universe with financials, scores, UBO-adjacent linkage; the de-facto registry reseller.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: BORME open data + paid Registro Mercantil deposited accounts + BOE — their entire base layer is public; we can replicate the event layer free via the BORME API, while per-company financials remain paid at the registry.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Ratings, company data and risk scores on Spanish companies; MARF rating agency presence.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: BORME, deposited accounts via Registradores, RPC insolvency register, court/gazette edicts.

competitorAnalysis.platform: Iberinform / Insight View (Crédito y Caución, local)
competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Company risk data platform on Spain/Portugal.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Same public base: BORME, Registro Mercantil accounts, RPC.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: VERIFIED live. Long-run Spanish VC/PE statistics, reports and 30k-article news archive; the historical-series reference for the market.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: SpainCap surveys, CNMV ECR register, self-collected deal press — its published aggregates are citable context.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Spanish real-estate data/analytics platform + free news arm (brainsre.news, verified RSS).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Catastro open data, Registradores property data, SOCIMI filings on BME Growth, land-registry statistics — the public RE layer we can also tap.

searchedButAbsent: Searched but not found / not verifiable this run: (1) a direct machine-readable list URL for the CNMV MiCA CASP register (register confirmed to exist on the portal, concrete list endpoint to be resolved at harvest); (2) SpainCap /en/partners/ page — 404; member data lives on /quienes-somos/organizacion/socios/* pages and the Anuario PDF; (3) any free bulk download of Spanish company financial statements — deposited accounts are paid-per-document at Registradores (no open route exists; Informa/Axesor pay for it too); (4) public UBO register access — restricted in the EU, correctly not cataloged; (5) a Spanish litigation-funding association or public litigation-funder register — none exists; litigation-finance entities must come via commercial-register + press; (6) RSS endpoints for El Economista, El Confidencial, Cinco Días and Europa Press could not be confirmed live because those hosts block this fetcher (403/connection refused) — recorded URLs follow each publisher's documented feed pattern and are marked js-blocked, to be re-verified from the pipeline crawler UA; (7) AELR (leasing/renting association) and ASPAC (insolvency administrators association) were left out rather than padded, since I could not verify a canonical URL this run; (8) old Banco de España register URL (/wbe/.../registros-entidades/) 404s — replaced by the verified app.bde.es/rbe_spa/home portal.
